source_record_locations.fact: _record samples wall_ns before deepcopy(value); actual_A_collection is recorded after the actual collector returns.
RPC return precedes snapshot/contract/budget reply binding and the real 60ms cutoff check. The two_choice_reply event is recorded after that cutoff check.
final_local_and_receiver_check follows a new actual collection, own view and fresh validation after choose; it is not a decision-return timestamp.

Caller body includes request encode, pipe write/flush, response wait/decode, identity checks, decoding the saved outgoing request and ledger append. Its sampled end precedes final sample-field writes and function return.

attribution_limits: RPC caller minus worker wall is a composite containing codec, transport, scheduling/wait, ledger and other overhead. It is not an independently isolated copy, IPC, or pure Python cost and cannot be subtracted as one.
No collection substage, binary hashing, endpoint-query or individual deepcopy duration is isolated by this report.
The two saved candidate outcomes are eligible worker predictions, but the actual caller correctly retained the default after the unchanged decision cutoff.
This clarification makes no speedup, cold-start, full32 or complete-request 100ms claim.
